author: Claudinei5557
quote:
After 22 hours and 50% into GTA 6, here are my thoughts.

GTA 5’s story took me about 25 hours to finish the first time, so this one is roughly double the size.

Pros:
- Amazing graphics and world
- New wanted system is a big improvement
- Robberies and optional quests are much better
- Clothing, vehicle ownership, money, and bank accounts actually matter (unlike GTA 5)
- NPCs are light-years ahead of GTA 5

Cons:
- Story is pretty bad so far; nearly everything is just “we needed money”
- Missions are solid but way less engaging without a good story
- No real character development like RDR2
- Lucia is annoying, Jason is boring; neither has unique traits or abilities
- Realism goes too far with vehicle damage, weapon/ammo storage, and car theft (literally the *grand theft auto* part)
- Excessive hand-holding
- Huge game/map size means many mechanics still aren’t unlocked at 50%
- Combat is good but not amazing
- Traffic density is a tad too high
